headline: Appellate Division upholds ruling: Caretaker government and referendum system return to Constitution
summary: The court's decision partially cancels the 15th Amendment, restoring key democratic provisions for election management and national voting.
details: The Appellate Division, led by the Chief Justice, has upheld a High Court ruling that partially cancels the 15th Amendment of the Constitution of Bangladesh.
caption:
A historic legal shift: The caretaker government and referendum systems are returning to the Bangladesh Constitution.

The Appellate Division, led by the Chief Justice, has upheld a High Court ruling that partially cancels the 15th Amendment of the Constitution of Bangladesh.

headline_marked: 5 [[killed in Bandarban landslides]] after heavy rainfall
headline: 5 killed in Bandarban landslides after heavy rainfall
summary: Two families were buried under debris in Lama upazila early today, including a five-year-old child.
details: Five members of two families, including a child, were killed in two separate landslides triggered by heavy rainfall in Lama upazila of Bandarban early today.

The incidents occurred in Mission Para (Paglir Jhiri) of Aziznagar union between 2:00 am and 4:00 am. The first landslide killed a husband and wife, while a second landslide an hour and a half later buried a husband, wife, and their five-year-old son.
The deceased have been identified as Md Yunus (40), Ranu Akter (35), Md Jewel (34), Kulsuma Akter (25), and five-year-old Md Soleman.
Local residents and the fire service conducted rescue operations to recover the bodies from the debris after hearing cries for help.
Continuous rainfall has heightened the risk of further landslides across Lama and other parts of Bandarban, with flooding disrupting daily life and road communication.
District administration has urged residents in landslide-prone areas to move to safer shelters, though many remain reluctant to leave their homes.
Heavy rain has also disrupted mobile network services and road connectivity in various upazilas of the district.
